title: Find Duplicate File in System
summary: Given a list of directory information, return all the duplicate file paths based on their contents.
statement: Given a list of directory information, return all the duplicate file paths based on their contents. Each directory info string includes the directory path and file names with their contents. The output should list the paths of all files that have the same content. A file path is formatted as "directory_path/file_name.txt".
constraints: 1 <= len(paths) <= 20,000; each directory description contains at least one file.
Return only content groups containing at least two paths; group and path order do not matter.
hints: File content is the grouping key.
Parse each file token and map its content to the complete path.
For every token, split name from parenthesized content; return map values of size at least two.
A hash map gathers files that are far apart in the input without comparing every pair.
editorial: A hash map gathers files that are far apart in the input without comparing every pair.

tests.explanation: Files with content abcd form one group, while the three efgh files form the other.
All contents are unique, so there are no duplicate groups.
